batman.pitch: Bruce Wayne is Gotham City’s masked detective. Armed with training, technology, and an obsession with justice, he hunts the criminals who prey on the city that took his parents.
overview: Bruce Wayne was a child when he saw his parents murdered in Gotham. He spent years studying combat, detection, and forensic science before coming home to fight the kind of crime that had shattered his family.

Batman’s partnership with James Gordon gives him an ally inside a deeply compromised police department. The Robins and the wider Bat-Family complicate his reputation as a loner: many of his most consequential stories ask what happens when he trusts someone else with the work, or when someone else has to wear the cowl.

batman-year-one.note: Bruce Wayne and James Gordon confront Gotham’s corruption in a foundational story about Batman’s beginnings and his most important police alliance.

batman-owls.note: A secret society forces Bruce to question everything he knows about Gotham in a detective story that makes an accessible starting point.

batman-dkr.note: An older Bruce Wayne returns to the cowl in a self-contained alternate future that explores what Batman’s return means for Gotham.

batman-zoo.note: A young Bruce faces masked killers without the Wayne fortune or Alfred in an alternate Gotham that reshapes Batman’s origins.

batman-one-million.note: The Batman of the 853rd century, published as part of DC One Million.

batman-darkest-knight.note: Bruce Wayne receives Abin Sur's ring and becomes a Green Lantern.

green-lantern.pitch: Green Lantern is a mantle carried by heroes like Hal Jordan and John Stewart. Their rings turn willpower into weapons, shields, and anything else they can imagine in defense of their sector.
overview: Hal Jordan was a test pilot when a dying alien, Abin Sur, entrusted him with a power ring and responsibility for Earth’s sector. The ring made Hal part of the Green Lantern Corps, an interstellar force whose members use willpower to give their ideas physical form.

John Stewart started as a relief Lantern and grew into a Corps leader. His background as an architect shapes how he builds constructs, which is one of the clearest examples of how the same ring can look and feel different in different hands. The guide separates the people who carry the mantle from alternate realities and transformations.

fantastic-four.pitch: The Fantastic Four are Marvel’s family of explorers. A flight through cosmic radiation gives Reed Richards, Sue Storm, Johnny Storm, and Ben Grimm extraordinary abilities and sends them toward even stranger frontiers.
overview: The four come home from their flight changed in different ways. Reed can stretch his body, Sue can become invisible and project force fields, Johnny can ignite and fly, and Ben gains immense strength along with a rocky body he can’t simply switch off.

Their adventures revolve around a family learning to live with those changes while exploring places that ordinary science cannot reach. Doctor Doom’s rivalry with Reed gives those discoveries a recurring personal cost. Later, the Future Foundation brings the Richards children and a new generation of problem-solvers into the story.

versions.name: Ultimate Fantastic Four
versions.description: The original Ultimate line reintroduces Reed, Sue, Johnny, and Ben as a younger team. It gives their experiments and family dynamic a new starting point, separate from the original Lee and Kirby run.

versions.name: Future Foundation
versions.description: The family reorganizes after losing Johnny and invites Spider-Man into the group. The Foundation gives the Richards children and other young scientists a place to tackle problems of their own.

versions.name: The Fantastick Four
versions.description: The 1602 world reimagines Reed, Sue, Johnny, and Ben as the Fantastick Four in an age of sailing ships and royal intrigue. Their period setting and adventures distinguish them from the modern Marvel family.

versions.name: Fantastic Four 2099
versions.description: In Karla Pacheco and Steven Cummings’s dystopian future, a new quartet takes up the Fantastic Four legacy. This is the 2019 team, distinct from both the original family and the 1996 Fantastic Four 2099 series.

ff-worlds-greatest.note: Read this collection for the original flight, the team’s early experiments with its powers, and the start of Doom’s rivalry with Reed.
